scenarios.name: Install state
scenarios.contract_scope: Empty and populated registered-source discovery; no scanning or automatic launch.
scenarios.native_requirement: Actual installed-product records and explicit absent/present desktop UI checks.

scenarios.name: Peer discovery
scenarios.contract_scope: Bounded installed/running/pipe discovery from explicit product-owned sources.
scenarios.native_requirement: Actual QingJian Desktop registration, running instance and approved pipe composition.

scenarios.name: Trust
scenarios.contract_scope: Fail-closed OS-fact/installation/publisher/approval policy with synthetic evidence.
scenarios.native_requirement: Real connection-handle SID/PID plus binary signature, publisher and approved installation.

scenarios.name: Handshake
scenarios.contract_scope: Observable connected, handshake, authenticated, session and negotiated stages.
scenarios.native_requirement: Real two-product V1 exchange over current-user Named Pipe.

scenarios.name: Capability negotiation
scenarios.contract_scope: Only known requested V1 capabilities; connection alone grants no content.
scenarios.native_requirement: Actual product capability owners and per-scope permission center.

scenarios.name: Metadata context
scenarios.contract_scope: Metadata capsule contains no selection, manuscript or prompt.
scenarios.native_requirement: Actual products with synthetic project metadata and independent settings.

scenarios.name: Selection context
scenarios.contract_scope: Selected text is rejected without explicit scope consent; authorized preview only.
scenarios.native_requirement: Real editor selection preview/consent with synthetic text.

scenarios.name: Chapter context
scenarios.contract_scope: Current chapter is rejected without explicit consent; current-version binding.
scenarios.native_requirement: Real chapter/version preview/consent with synthetic text.

scenarios.name: Diagnostic
scenarios.contract_scope: Strict non-content diagnostic and bounded audit allowlists.
scenarios.native_requirement: Native diagnostic source and audit sink inspection with synthetic credentials.

scenarios.name: Event
scenarios.contract_scope: Metadata projection, direct/poll/synthetic provenance and isolated subscriber revocation.
scenarios.native_requirement: Native producer event hooks and actual cross-product subscription delivery.

scenarios.name: Session revoke
scenarios.contract_scope: Disconnect revokes the local session and cancels pending delivery.
scenarios.native_requirement: Actual transport/session/subscription cancellation on both products.

scenarios.name: Permission revoke
scenarios.contract_scope: Fresh authorization at event delivery; revoke A while B continues.
scenarios.native_requirement: Two real subscribers with independent live permissions.

scenarios.name: Tutor guidance
scenarios.contract_scope: Actual frozen TutorRequest/TutorGuidance exchange; advice performs no mutation.
scenarios.native_requirement: Actual Tutor orchestrator/ContextAssembler composition, without paid model invocation.

scenarios.name: Verifier
scenarios.contract_scope: Fresh-state boundary; untrusted wire authority never proves verification.
scenarios.native_requirement: Actual Verifier owner with independently trusted current source and permission revision.

scenarios.name: Deep Link
scenarios.contract_scope: Single-use, bounded, locally issued user-presence token and current target resolution.
scenarios.native_requirement: Real Windows URI registration plus user-click navigation.

scenarios.name: Model Registry
scenarios.contract_scope: Read-only ModelRegistry projection, secret rejection and stale cache.
scenarios.native_requirement: Actual QingJian Model Scheduler projection and source freshness.

scenarios.name: Tutor crash
scenarios.contract_scope: Synthetic peer failure cannot produce a usable response.
scenarios.native_requirement: Real Tutor process crash and subsequent host recovery.

scenarios.name: Studio crash
scenarios.contract_scope: Simulated host shutdown revokes volatile session/grant state.
scenarios.native_requirement: Real Studio process crash, no surviving sender, and restart identity.

scenarios.name: Restart
scenarios.contract_scope: Fresh instance on restart; no session or standing-grant restoration.
scenarios.native_requirement: Real desktop restart with non-restored content and standing-event grants.

scenarios.name: Upgrade compatibility
scenarios.contract_scope: Product version compatibility, existing 1.0 selection and unknown-major refusal.
scenarios.native_requirement: Real product upgrade/install identity and signature revalidation.

scenarios.name: Different Windows user
scenarios.contract_scope: A genuine separately authenticated Windows-user client must be denied by another SID pipe.
scenarios.native_requirement: Run the distinct-user Windows probe; same-user CI is not evidence for this scenario.

scenarios.name: Fake product_id
scenarios.contract_scope: Claimed known product ID without approved installation must fail production policy.
scenarios.native_requirement: Real hostile process plus trusted installer registry/signature evidence.

scenarios.name: Expired session
scenarios.contract_scope: Fixed session expiry rejects use; heartbeat cannot extend the original expiry.
scenarios.native_requirement: Real two-product elapsed session expiry without implicit renewal.

scenarios.name: Offline
scenarios.contract_scope: Missing peer/bridge failure remains isolated from host application startup.
scenarios.native_requirement: Offline actual user-machine acceptance and host startup timing.
